held_verdicts.description: D-34: full deliberation of each HELD position (not just a fold of voice lines)

data_anchors.description: price vs ATR range, distance to structural levels, sc_momentum/mp_state, unrealised/R-multiple

sector_exposure_note.description: D-34: committee flag on held-book sector concentration for the Risk over-exposure check

deliberation_set.description: Every ticker that reached >=2 nominations (D-2) or lens top tier, event-filter-cleared, entering deliberation

bear_case.description: MANDATORY (RB:committee.bear_case_mandatory; performance.committee.bear_case_present_pct_min=100) — the strongest reason NOT to take this name, stated plainly, even on an ADVANCE

dissent.description: Recorded, never suppressed — empty array is a valid outcome (true unanimity), not an assumed default

unanimity_challenge_triggered.description: RB:committee.unanimity_challenge — preliminary >=6/7 agreement triggers rotating adversarial challenge (thorp/pardo/steenbarger)

conditions.description: Required (non-null) when verdict is HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS; null otherwise

data_anchors.description: D-20 anti-black-box: the decisive field values behind this verdict, carried up from the nominations' field_values (e.g. {"nomination_count": 4, "lens_positive": 7, "bracket.rr": 2.79, "bracket.stop": 17.82, "rvol": 1.4}). The PM reads the numbers that drove the call, not just the prose. committee-desk populates it from what the voices cited.

ledger_proposal.description: D-83: the committee's OWN call on whether this name is worth keeping in the Pipeline Ledger after today. Only names the committee proposes are filed — post-market does NOT sweep everything that failed to advance. Omit or set null to propose nothing (the default for a genuinely dead name). Made once, here, at deliberation time — no extra spawn, no second judgement pass later.

propose.description: true = file it. false/absent = drop it (logged in committee.json, not carried forward).

classification.description: daily_reconsider = re-fed into tomorrow's tally so it is re-scored fresh every morning. trigger_silent = parked and silent; only resurfaces when `trigger` fires on the market-hours sweep.

field.description: an AQE export field (e.g. sc_momentum, structure, price) — must be a field the daily export actually carries

trigger.description: REQUIRED when classification is trigger_silent; null otherwise. A trigger_silent row with no trigger is a contradiction and pipeline_ledger.py rejects it.

reason.description: why this setup is worth carrying — the committee's own words, stored as case_snapshot so re-surfacing never needs a re-nomination
